name.ja: 滑らかな関数の多項式補間・射影
name.en: Polynomial interpolation and projection of a smooth function

caption.ja: 保存済み8次多項式の射影・補間と元の関数。
caption.en: Stored degree-8 projection/interpolation and the original function.

equation_note.ja: 指定関数の多項式射影・補間であり、支配方程式の求解ではありません。
equation_note.en: Polynomial projection/interpolation of a prescribed function, rather than a governing-equation solve.

name.ja: 滑らかな関数：Legendre射影とGLL補間
name.en: Smooth function: Legendre projection and GLL interpolation

note.ja: 重み1の区間射影とGLL節点補間で、PDEではない。32点求積による射影を、別のLegendre再帰式と64/96点求積で調べる。実行例の式は46モデルの件数に足さない。
note.en: Unit-weight interval projection and GLL interpolation, not a PDE. The 32-point projection is checked by a separate Legendre recurrence and 64/96-point rules; example formulas do not add to the 46 model entries.

reference_note.ja: 指定された滑らかな対象関数の既知値を基準に、Legendre射影・節点補間の誤差を比較します。方程式を解いたデータではありません。
reference_note.en: Compare Legendre-projection and nodal-interpolation errors against known values of the specified smooth function. These data do not solve a governing equation.

name.ja: Legendreモード基底・正規直交化

method_note.ja: この問題への対応が共通の固定入力・実行例で明示された手法です。図と実行例の条件の違いは入力で確認してください。
method_note.en: Methods explicitly bound to this problem by the common fixed-input execution example. Inspect its input for differences from the figure’s conditions.

name.ja: 滑らかな関数：Legendre射影とGLL補間
name.en: Smooth function: Legendre projection and GLL interpolation

scope.ja: exp(x)を次数2/4/6/8でL2射影し、同じ次数のGLL節点補間と比較する。実装の32点Gaussとは別の64/96点求積と独立Legendre再帰式で係数・直交性・誤差を確認する。
scope.en: L2-project exp(x) at degrees 2/4/6/8 and compare GLL interpolation at the same degrees. Check coefficients, orthogonality and errors using separate 64/96-point rules and an independent Legendre recurrence, versus 32-point projection quadrature.

assumptions.ja: 参照区間[−1,1]、重み1のLegendre内積。GLLはp+1節点。高次求積の一致を参照精度の補助検査とし、一般関数の厳密積分とは主張しない。出力201点は誤差積分用の求積点とは別。
assumptions.en: Reference interval [−1,1] and unit-weight Legendre inner product; GLL has p+1 nodes. Agreement of higher-order rules supports reference accuracy but is not an exact-integration claim for arbitrary functions. The 201 output points are separate from error quadrature.

limits.ja: exp(x)・GLL・次数増加・参照求積を固定し、非有限値や不適切な次数・参照求積数を拒否。不連続関数、高次数での安定性、曲線要素やPDE全体の検証ではない。解説本文は現在英語版。
limits.en: Fix exp(x), GLL, degree refinement and reference quadrature; reject nonfinite/invalid degrees or inadequate reference rules. Not validation for discontinuities, high-degree stability, curved elements or a full PDE. The current reading is English only.

reference_note.ja: CSVは次数ごとに201点、各行で射影値・GLL補間値・exp(x)を整列。次数別L2誤差、係数差、直交性残差、64/96点求積の差はJSONに記録する。
reference_note.en: CSV provides 201 aligned projection/interpolation/exp(x) rows per degree. JSON records degree-wise L2 errors, coefficient differences, orthogonality and 64/96-point quadrature agreement.

description.ja: CSVは次数ごとに201点、各行で射影値・GLL補間値・exp(x)を整列。次数別L2誤差、係数差、直交性残差、64/96点求積の差はJSONに記録する。
description.en: CSV provides 201 aligned projection/interpolation/exp(x) rows per degree. JSON records degree-wise L2 errors, coefficient differences, orthogonality and 64/96-point quadrature agreement.

description.ja: exp(x)を直接評価し、異なる高次求積と独立の三項再帰でモード係数を求め直す。射影自身の求積値の再利用による自明な一致ではない。
description.en: Direct exp(x) evaluation plus different high-order quadrature and a separate three-term recurrence recompute modal coefficients; the reference does not reuse the projection's own quadrature.
